lines: He texts, “Why didn’t you answer right away?”
His words get sharper, like a knot tightening.
He isn’t caring about you, he’s timing your return.
Every minute you wait becomes his scoreboard.
If his messages make you uneasy, pause.
Your minutes belong to you, not his schedule.
Remember, you decide who gets your time.
